import sys
import math

class Main:
    def main(self):
        in_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
        n = int(in_data[0])
        index = 1
        circles = []
        for _ in range(n):
            x = int(in_data[index])
            y = int(in_data[index + 1])
            r = int(in_data[index + 2])
            index += 3
            circles.append(self.Circle(self.Point(x, y), r))
        all_points = set()
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                inter = self.intersect(circles[i], circles[j])
                if inter is None:
                    continue
                all_points.update(inter)
        point_id = {}
        adj = []
        for _ in range(n):
            angles = [2 * math.pi * j / 3 for j in range(3)]
            for p in all_points:
                if circles[_].contains(p):
                    dx = p.x - circles[_].o.x
                    dy = p.y - circles[_].o.y
                    alpha = math.atan2(dy, dx)
                    if alpha < 0:
                        alpha += 2 * math.pi
                    angles.append(alpha)
            angles.sort()
            dir_point = self.Point(1, 0).scale(circles[_].r)
            as_list = sorted(set(angles))
            for a in as_list:
                p = circles[_].o.add(dir_point.rotate(a))
                self.get_id(p, point_id, adj)
            for j in range(len(as_list)):
                p = circles[_].o.add(dir_point.rotate(as_list[j]))
                q = circles[_].o.add(dir_point.rotate(as_list[(j + 1) % len(as_list)]))
                u = point_id[p]
                v = point_id[q]
                if u == v:
                    continue
                adj[u].append(v)
                adj[v].append(u)
        v = len(adj)
        e = sum(len(neigh) for neigh in adj) // 2
        visited = [False] * v
        comps = 0
        for i in range(v):
            if not visited[i]:
                comps += 1
                self.dfs(i, visited, adj)
        print(1 + comps + e - v)

    def dfs(self, i, visited, adj):
        visited[i] = True
        for j in adj[i]:
            if not visited[j]:
                self.dfs(j, visited, adj)

    def get_id(self, p, point_id, adj):
        if p not in point_id:
            point_id[p] = len(point_id)
            adj.append([])

    def intersect(self, c1, c2):
        dx = c1.o.x - c2.o.x
        dy = c1.o.y - c2.o.y
        d = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
        if d == 0:
            return None
        cos_value = (c1.r * c1.r + d * d - c2.r * c2.r) / (2 * c1.r * d)
        eps = 1e-8
        if cos_value < -1 - eps:
            return None
        if cos_value < -1:
            cos_value = -1
        if cos_value > 1 + eps:
            return None
        if cos_value > 1:
            cos_value = 1
        alpha = math.acos(cos_value)
        dir_vec = c2.o.sub(c1.o).norm()
        res = []
        res.append(c1.o.add(dir_vec.scale(c1.r).rotate(+alpha)))
        res.append(c1.o.add(dir_vec.scale(c1.r).rotate(-alpha)))
        return res

    class Point:
        def __init__(self, x, y):
            self.x = x
            self.y = y

        def add(self, o):
            return Main.Point(self.x + o.x, self.y + o.y)

        def sub(self, o):
            return Main.Point(self.x - o.x, self.y - o.y)

        def rotate(self, alpha):
            c = math.cos(alpha)
            s = math.sin(alpha)
            nx = self.x * c - self.y * s
            ny = self.x * s + self.y * c
            return Main.Point(nx, ny)

        def norm(self):
            length = self.length()
            if length == 0:
                return Main.Point(0, 0)
            return self.scale(1.0 / length)

        def scale(self, f):
            return Main.Point(self.x * f, self.y * f)

        def length(self):
            return math.sqrt(self.x * self.x + self.y * self.y)

        def __str__(self):
            return f"{self.x:.6f} {self.y:.6f}"

        def __eq__(self, other):
            eps = 1e-8
            return abs(self.x - other.x) < eps and abs(self.y - other.y) < eps

        def __hash__(self):
            return hash((round(self.x, 8), round(self.y, 8)))

        def __lt__(self, other):
            eps = 1e-8
            if abs(self.x - other.x) > eps:
                return self.x < other.x
            if abs(self.y - other.y) > eps:
                return self.y < other.y
            return False

    class Circle:
        def __init__(self, o, r):
            self.o = o
            self.r = r

        def contains(self, p):
            dist = p.sub(self.o).length()
            return abs(dist - self.r) < 1e-8

if __name__ == "__main__":
    Main().main()
